evals.prompt: Write the task for opencode: add pagination to GET /jobs in api/routes.py (page, page_size, default 20).
evals.expected_output: Reads the route and an existing paginated pattern first; task.md lists exact files, test-first steps, an exact runnable test command, edge cases (page 0, page beyond end, page_size cap), and out-of-scope items.
assertions: Reads the route and an existing paginated pattern before writing
Lists exact files it may change/create
Steps are test-first
Gives an exact runnable test command
Covers page 0 / beyond the end / page_size cap edge cases
Has an Out of scope section

evals.prompt: Make a task to clean up and improve the books backend.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to write a vague task: asks what concretely to change or tells orchestrate it must be split; no 'improve/clean up' wording in a spec.
assertions: Does not write a task from the vague request
Asks what concretely to change or says the work must be split first
Uses no 'improve/clean up' wording in a spec

evals.prompt: T2 was rejected: it changed web/src/App.tsx which wasn't allowed, and the empty-list case returns 500. Update the task for attempt 2.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the task, bumps attempt to 2, adds 'Notes from review' with file:line, the problem and the concrete fix for each point.
assertions: Keeps the existing task content
Bumps attempt to 2
Adds Notes from review with file:line, problem and fix for each point
Covers both the App.tsx scope violation and the empty-list 500

evals.prompt: Write the task for opencode: upgrade vitest from 3 to 5 in web/ (web/package.json has vite ^5.4 and vitest ^3.2; .github/workflows/ci.yml uses node-version 18; web/Dockerfile is FROM node:18-alpine AS build). vitest 5 declares peerDependencies vite ^6 || ^7 || ^8 and engines node ^20.19 || >=22.12.
evals.expected_output: A task.md whose Context names vitest 5's requirements (vite >= 6, Node >= 20.19) and that handles them: either vite is upgraded in the same task (files list includes package.json and package-lock.json) or the spec depends on a prior vite task; the Node 18 pins in ci.yml and the Dockerfile are included in this task's files or flagged as a required prior task. Exact test command present.
assertions: Context lists vitest 5's peer requirement on vite >= 6
Context lists the Node engine requirement (>= 20.19 / 22.12)
The vite upgrade is part of this task or an explicit dependency
The Node 18 pins in .github/workflows/ci.yml and web/Dockerfile are in the files list or an explicit dependency
An exact runnable test command is given

evals.prompt: You are the orchestrator's spec subagent. Write .orchestra/2026-11-23-export/tasks/T3.task.md for board row 'T3 | 1 | CSV export endpoint | opencode | T1 | api/export.py, tests/test_export.py | todo'. The plan docs/plans/2026-11-23-export-plan.md section 'T3 CSV export endpoint' already gives the function signature, the CSV columns, the 4 test cases and the test command.
evals.expected_output: Writes a task.md that points to the plan section instead of copying its signature, columns and test cases; adds only what the plan leaves open; keeps files and the exact test command; replies with the path only.
assertions: The task.md references the plan section (path + heading) for the design details
It does not restate the plan's columns and all 4 test cases verbatim
It still pins the files and an exact test command
The reply to the orchestrator is the task path only (or BLOCKED: …)
